title: A keep of emotions, stories and love
paragraphs: Growing up, I had witnessed weddingb sarees and lehengas being passed down like xacred heirlooms, each one holding the scent of nostalgia and the shimmer of legacy. But overtime, I saw that essence being lost in mass production, bridalwear became about trends, not timelessness.

I started this couture brand to create pieces that feel deeply personal, yet exquisitely regal, bridal and tousseau clothing that celebrates individualtiy while echoing heritage. Every fabric is carefully chosen for its texture and story, every package is a keepsake, every stitch speaks to the brides journey.

Brides today are redefining narratives, they just don't want to wear luxury, they want to feel it, live it and remember it, I created this brand to stand beside them in that journey, to be a part of their once in a lifetime story.
